fields.subject: FW: Confirmation: Network Segregation and Forensic Preservation
fields.note:
Anil, 

This confirms that CVG-OT-JMP01 has been fully isolated from the business network. All remote access to the jump host has been blocked. The audit logs from CVG-OT-JMP01 have been preserved and are available for forensic review. Halden Automation has been notified and has agreed to begin reviewing the halden-support account access logs for the 16:15 session. We will not authorize any resumption of remote access until after the forensic review is complete and CISA confirms the environment is secure.

—R. Thompson

original.subject: Confirmation: Network Segregation and Forensic Preservation
original.body:
Hi Anil,

We confirm that CVG-OT-JMP01 has been fully isolated from the business network. All remote access to the jump host has been blocked. The audit logs from CVG-OT-JMP01 have been preserved and are available for forensic review. Halden Automation has been notified and has agreed to begin reviewing the halden-support account access logs for the 16:15 session. We will not authorize any resumption of remote access until after the forensic review is complete and CISA confirms the environment is secure.

—TSA Contact: R. Thompson, Pipeline Security Division
